stories.title: Romo pleads no contest to OWI, to seek help
stories.summary: Ex-Dallas Cowboys quarterback and CBS Sports lead football analyst Tony Romo pleaded no contest to OWI charges in Milwaukee. He will have driving privileges revoked for six months and will seek help from a team of doctors.

stories.title: Texans GM sets Week 1 deadline for Stroud talks
stories.summary: The Texans have set a Week 1 deadline for agreeing to a contract extension with quarterback C.J. Stroud this year, general manager Nick Caserio said.
